articles.title: NASA’s Hubble Reveals Largest Found Chaotic Birthplace of Planets
articles.summary: Astronomers using NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope have imaged the largest protoplanetary disk ever observed circling a young star. For the first time in visible light, Hubble has revealed the disk is unexpectedly chaotic and turbulent, with wisps of material stretching much farther above and below the disk than astronomers have seen in any similar system. articles.title: Long March 12A reaches orbit in first reusable launch attempt, but landing fails
articles.summary:
A first launch of the Long March 12A Chinese state-owned reusable rocket reached orbit late Monday, but attempted recovery of the first stage downrange failed.
